info.name: Pawfront E2E Scenario Suite
info.description:
Real-life end-to-end scenarios across BOTH hosts (provider Pawfront.Api + parent Pawfront.PetParentApi), with pm.test assertions and chained variables. Run TOP TO BOTTOM with the Collection Runner (or newman) against the 'Pawfront E2E' environment.

Prerequisites:
1. Both hosts running; latest DeployAll.sql deployed (the night-stay scenario depends on the 2026-07-11 GetBookingsForDate change).
2. A DEDICATED provider test account that is either unregistered or already registered as PetSitter (any other category gives 409 ServiceCategoryConflict in Scenario A).
3. A parent test account; `parentEmail` in the environment MUST be that account's Firebase email (event isBookable/cancel match on the JWT email claim).

Re-runs are safe: booking dates are randomised into the future per run, and every scenario cancels the bookings it created (except Scenario C, which ends in COMPLETED by design).
